title: 刚出炉的肉桂卷  (Hot Cinnamon Rolls)

segments.t: Back at Courtyard Inn, Teacher Song walks down at seven ten in her cardigan, hoping for hot tea before washing up. Mei and Manager Zhou launch their distraction plan. Listen first.
早上好！在楼上就闻到暖暖的肉桂香味了！
宋老师早！我的肉桂卷刚出烤箱。
快坐在向阳窗户边，宋老师！先别急着上楼！
其实我下楼是想问问，洗手间水龙头怎么有点凉。
凉？啊——对！老街水管早上需要慢慢热身！
先喝杯热茶，吃个肉桂卷坐十分钟吧！
早上七点有热乎乎的肉桂面包，谁会拒绝呢。
太明智了！旁边要配蜂蜜还是苹果果酱？
只要一点黄油，谢谢。周经理，您怎么老看手表？
我？哦，我只是喜欢准时！七点十四分真美妙！
周经理，看院子窗户外头——有人跑进大门了！
得救了！失陪一分钟，宋老师，您慢喝热茶！
Now let's go through it line by line with the English translation.
早上好！在楼上就闻到暖暖的肉桂香味了！
'Good morning! All the way upstairs I smelled warm cinnamon!'
宋老师早！我的肉桂卷刚出烤箱。
'Morning, Teacher Song! My cinnamon rolls just came out of the oven.'
快坐在向阳窗户边，宋老师！先别急着上楼！
'Sit right down by the sunny window, Teacher Song! No rush to go back upstairs yet!'
其实我下楼是想问问，洗手间水龙头怎么有点凉。
'Actually, I came down to ask why the bathroom tap felt a bit cool.'
凉？啊——对！老街水管早上需要慢慢热身！
'Cool? Ah—yes! Old-street water pipes need a gentle morning warm-up!'
先喝杯热茶，吃个肉桂卷坐十分钟吧！
'Have a cup of hot tea and a cinnamon roll for ten minutes first!'
早上七点有热乎乎的肉桂面包，谁会拒绝呢。
'At seven in the morning, who could say no to piping-hot cinnamon bread.'
太明智了！旁边要配蜂蜜还是苹果果酱？
'Wise choice! Would you like honey or apple jam on the side?'
只要一点黄油，谢谢。周经理，您怎么老看手表？
'Just a little butter, thank you. Manager Zhou, why do you keep looking at your watch?'
我？哦，我只是喜欢准时！七点十四分真美妙！
'Me? Oh, I simply love punctuality! Seven fourteen is a lovely minute!'
周经理，看院子窗户外头——有人跑进大门了！
'Manager Zhou, look out the courtyard window—someone just ran in the gate!'
得救了！失陪一分钟，宋老师，您慢喝热茶！
'Saved! Excuse me one minute, Teacher Song—enjoy your hot tea!'

Fresh cinnamon rolls bought the exact ten minutes they needed as Qing dashed back through the front gate. Let's head down to the boiler cellar next time. See you next time.
回头见！
